# WoodPrep

> AutoCAD plugin for furniture and cabinet manufacturers. It turns existing AutoCAD 3D drawings into production-ready output: Excel cutting lists, material and hardware summaries, and CNC programs for Biesse (Skipper, Rover), SCM and Homag machines — without redrawing anything in separate CAM software.

WoodPrep runs inside full AutoCAD 2021–2027 on Windows and is licensed per machine as a monthly subscription. Plans start at €50/month; the Enterprise plan with direct CNC output has custom pricing. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

The core idea: a furniture maker who already designs in AutoCAD should not have to re-enter part data into a separate cutting-optimization or CAM program. WoodPrep reads the solids in the drawing and writes the production files directly.

## Requirements

- Full AutoCAD 2021–2027 on Windows.
- Not AutoCAD LT (Autodesk does not allow plug-ins in LT) and not AutoCAD for Mac.
- Not a standalone program — it runs inside AutoCAD.
- CNC output (Enterprise) requires AutoCAD 2025–2027.
- The 14-day free trial works on AutoCAD 2021–2027: fill in the short form on the [home page](https://woodprep.eu/#demo), choose your AutoCAD version, and the matching download appears immediately.

## What it does

- **Cutting lists to Excel** — collects every board part from the drawing with sizes and quantities, imported into a companion Excel workbook in one click.
- **Hardware lists** — scans layers prefixed `VAS_` and builds a complete hardware summary with quantities.
- **Edge banding and grain direction** — each of the four edges of a part can get its own edge material and thickness; grain direction can be locked or left free for cutting optimization.
- **Batch processing** — one command walks every cabinet part in the drawing, so no part is missed. Hardware layers are skipped automatically.
- **Identical part and mirror pair detection** — matches parts by both dimensions and hole pattern, groups them, and fills in quantities. Mirror detection handles left/right pairs such as cabinet sides and door pairs.
- **Parametric cabinet generation** — builds complete carcasses from parameters: doors (overlay or inset, left or right swing), drawers sized automatically for Blum 560F undermount slides with 16 mm or 18 mm drawer boxes, auto-positioned hinges, shelf pins, minifix connectors, and open shelf units with curved arched sides.
- **Generate from floor plan** — reads room dimensions from an existing floor plan drawing and generates carcass geometry.
- **CNC program output (Enterprise)** — writes BPP files for Biesse Skipper and Rover, SCM format, or .mpr programs for Homag that open in woodWOP, including the hole pattern, alongside the cutting list.
- **Geometry helpers** — boolean joint finalization, back panel recess subtraction by layer, bounding size readout, and revealing hidden parts.

## Who it is for

Furniture and cabinet manufacturers, kitchen makers, and shopfitters who already model in AutoCAD and want to skip manual data entry between design and production. Especially relevant for shops running Biesse, SCM or Homag CNC machinery, and for anyone currently retyping part lists into cutting-optimization software by hand.

## Plans

All prices are per machine, per month.

- [Basic](https://woodprep.eu/plan-basic.html) — **€50/month**: Excel cutting and hardware lists, bounding size, show hidden parts. No batch processing, no joint finalization or back panel extraction, no CNC output.
- [Starter](https://woodprep.eu/plan-starter.html) — **€75/month**: adds batch cabinet processing, identical part detection, mirror pair detection, joint finalization, and back panel extraction.
- [Professional](https://woodprep.eu/plan-professional.html) — **€95/month**: adds parametric cabinet design — door cabinets, Blum 560F drawer cabinets, and generation from floor plans.
- [Enterprise](https://woodprep.eu/plan-enterprise.html) — **custom pricing**: adds direct CNC machine output for Biesse Rover, Biesse Skipper, SCM, and Homag (.mpr for woodWOP). Every machine is configured and tested during setup.

## Add-on modules

Add-ons are optional modules that attach to any plan — Basic, Starter, Professional or Enterprise alike. They are billed per machine on top of the existing subscription, so no plan upgrade is needed to get them.

- [Panel Cutting Optimization](https://woodprep.eu/panelcut.html) (PANELCUT, €30 per machine per month): generates optimized cutting maps from the parts on a chosen layer of the AutoCAD drawing. Board size, saw blade thickness (kerf) and edge trim allowance are configurable to match the actual saw, and every board is reported with its offcut waste and material utilisation. Both the summary sheet and the cutting maps can be printed for the shop floor.

Two further modules are in development: extended edge banding handling, and full job costing combining board, edge banding, hardware and labour.
